Each letter past 9+3
  • No letter values — only word length counts. Past 9 letters, every extra letter adds 3 (FLAMETHROWERS, 13 letters = 28).
  • The app scores what is physically on the board: every unbroken across or down run of 2+ tiles is one word. It never splits a run (TABLERUNNER is checked as TABLERUNNER).
  • Any invalid or misspelled word scores 0 and makes the board NOT CLEAN.
  • +10 finishing bonus goes to the first finisher only with a CLEAN board. If not clean, the other player gets it only if their board is clean. Neither clean: no bonus. Decided only after both boards are checked.
  • Nothing counts until you tap Finalize round. Edit / undo last round puts it back for review.
  • First to 250 wins. Both past it in the same round: higher total wins.

Dictionary: — words — the ENABLE word-game list combined with Hunspell en_US, plus newer two/three-letter tile words (OK, EW, ZA, QI). Not the official tournament list, so you can overrule any word by tapping it.
